title: Usambara Mountains and Lushoto: Hiking Between Villages
excerpt: The Usambara Mountains offer green hills, cool air and village walks around Lushoto. A relaxing contrast to safari.
body:
The Usambara Mountains in northeastern Tanzania are known for their cool climate, forests and farming villages. The town of Lushoto is the main base.

## Hiking

Walks lead through villages, terraced fields and forests to viewpoints such as Irente, with views over the plains far below. Hikes range from a few hours to several days with nights in villages or guesthouses.

## Villages and culture

The Sambaa people live here. Walking with a local guide is the best way to learn about farming, daily life and history. The German colonial period also left traces in buildings around Lushoto.

## Nature

The Usambaras belong to the Eastern Arc Mountains, home to unique plants such as the African violet, which originally comes from this region, and chameleons.

## Climate

Cool, especially in the evenings. Bring a fleece.

## Combine

With [Mkomazi](/blog/mkomazi-rhino-sanctuary/), [Saadani](/blog/saadani-bush-meets-beach/) or the coast at [Pangani](/blog/tanzania-coast-beyond-zanzibar/).

Read our [Usambara page](/national-parks/usambara-mountains/) or [plan your trip](/travel-proposal/).
